channel.title: El Salvador in English - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from El Salvador in English (elsalvadorinenglish.com)

item.title: El Salvador International Airport Ranked World’s No. 2 for Punctuality
item.description: El Salvador’s airport ranks second globally for punctuality, boasting a 91.7% on-time departure rate and serving over a million passengers.

item.title: International Institutions Signal Confidence in El Salvador’s Economic Future.
item.description: El Salvador’s economy gains global confidence as IMF-backed reforms, fiscal discipline, and improved security drive growth, attracting investment and strengthening the country’s financial outlook.…

item.title: How El Salvador’s 2026 Public Investment Program Is Driving Economic Expansion and Construction Growth.
item.description: El Salvador’s $2.68 billion 2026 investment plan aims to accelerate economic growth through infrastructure, education, and digital projects, with early signs pointing to stronger execution.

item.title: Tourism Boom in El Salvador: Record 815,000 Visitors Signal Strong 2026 Outlook.
item.description: El Salvador records 815,000 visitors in early 2026, signaling strong tourism growth driven by U.S. travelers, cruise arrivals, and expanding local investment.

item.title: U.S. Companies Recruit Salvadoran Talent for Seafood and Hospitality Jobs.
item.description: U.S. companies are increasingly recruiting Salvadoran workers for temporary roles in seafood and hospitality, highlighting strong labor ties and growing demand for reliable talent.

item.title: First Lady Gabriela de Bukele Awards Family Friendly Seal to El Salvador International Airport
item.description: El Salvador’s airport earned a “Family Friendly” seal, enhancing services for families traveling with children.

item.title: El Salvador Expands Global Innovation Reach as CUBO+ Delegation Travels to Japan
item.description: CUBO+ delegation to Japan enhances El Salvador’s technical education, fostering international collaboration and promoting innovation and talent globally.

item.title: El Salvador’s Agriculture Ministry Introduces Mobile Units to Sell Discounted Farm Inputs.
item.description: El Salvador launches mobile units to deliver low-cost fertilizers nationwide, aiming to reduce farming costs, boost production, and support thousands of local agricultural producers.

item.title: El Salvador Expands Renewable Energy with $44.8M Solar Project in Olocuilta.
item.description: El Salvador inaugurates a $44.8M solar plant in Olocuilta, boosting renewable energy capacity and signaling strong growth in sustainable investment and infrastructure development.

item.title: First Lady Gabriela de Bukele Announces “El Nido,” A High-Standard Maternity Hub.
item.description: El Salvador launches “El Nido,” a pioneering maternity center led by First Lady Gabriela de Bukele, aiming to redefine maternal care with innovation, dignity, and family-centered support.
